thread.author: system
thread.body: Secure conversation started. Messages are part of your medical record.

thread.author: patient
thread.body: Good morning doctor, the rash on my forearm has spread since Tuesday.

thread.author: clinician
thread.body: Thank you. Is it itchy or painful, and have you started any new medication in the last fortnight?

thread.author: patient
thread.body: Itchy, not painful. No new medication.

thread.author: clinician
thread.body: Understood. A very long clinical note follows to check wrapping behaviour: contact dermatitis is most likely given the distribution and the absence of systemic symptoms, however if you develop fever, facial swelling or difficulty breathing you should attend an emergency department immediately rather than waiting for our next scheduled consultation.
